messages.subject: Sage Green - workshop branding
messages.body: Hi Nadia, can you do a brand for our community workshop series? Nothing fancy, we're a non-profit.

messages.subject: Re: Sage Green - workshop branding
messages.body: Hi Grace, I'd be happy to. I do a reduced non-profit rate: 1,800 EUR for logo and basic guidelines.

messages.subject: Re: Sage Green - workshop branding
messages.body: Amazing, that's within our grant. Please go ahead! Send the agreement when you can.

messages.subject: Pitch deck
messages.body: Hi Ravi, Jonas passed on your details. I can take the pitch deck on. Let's have a call to scope it.

messages.subject: Re: Pitch deck
messages.body: Great. Free tomorrow afternoon?

messages.subject: Typeface Weekly: 10 new fonts for logos
messages.body: This week's picks: 10 new display fonts perfect for logo work. Plus: a client-proposal template giveaway. Unsubscribe anytime.

messages.subject: New episode: why small teams win
messages.body: This week we talk to a founder about staying small on purpose. Listen now on your favourite app.

messages.subject: Out of the blue - website freelancer?
messages.body: Hi, do you also build websites? Need a simple 5-page one for my plumbing business.

messages.subject: Re: Out of the blue - website freelancer?
messages.body: Hi Daniel, I'm a brand designer rather than a developer, but I can recommend a few people. Sorry I can't take this one.

messages.subject: Re: Out of the blue - website freelancer?
messages.body: No worries, a recommendation would be great.

messages.subject: Logo for new restaurant?
messages.body: Hi Nadia, we're opening a small cafe on the pier in May and need a logo and menu design. Saw your work for Harbour Bakery. Are you free for a chat this week?

messages.subject: Re: Logo for new restaurant?
messages.body: Hi Oliver, congrats! Yes, free Thursday 10am. I'll send a call link.

messages.subject: Haddad Legal - website graphics
messages.body: Hello. A colleague recommended you. We need some icons and a header illustration for our new site. Budget not decided yet. What's your rate?

messages.subject: Bloom & Branch - brand guidelines
messages.body: Hi Nadia, following up on the call. We'd like to proceed, but could you send the revised quote with the extra social templates?

messages.subject: Re: Bloom & Branch - brand guidelines
messages.body: Sure, revised: 4,250 EUR. Updated proposal attached.

messages.subject: Marini Foods label project
messages.body: Sofia here. We'd like to go ahead with the label redesign, the quote of 6,400 EUR is approved by finance. When can we kick off?

messages.subject: Re: Marini Foods label project
messages.body: Fantastic news! I can start on the 12th. I'll send over the kickoff questionnaire.

messages.subject: Brewery labels
messages.body: Dear Nadia, thank you for the proposal. Unfortunately we've decided to go with another studio that was cheaper. Wishing you all the best.

messages.subject: Re: Brewery labels
messages.body: Thanks for letting me know Hugo, best of luck with the launch.

messages.subject: Fwd: Intro - Ravi from Kite Analytics
messages.body:
Nadia, meet Ravi. He's looking for a designer for his startup's pitch deck. I'll let you two take it from here.

-------- Forwarded --------
From: Ravi Menon <ravi@kiteanalytics.example>
Hi Jonas, do you know a good designer for a pitch deck? Need it in 3 weeks.

messages.subject: Thank you!
messages.body: The packaging samples arrived and they look incredible. Thank you!!

messages.subject: Reminder: Dentist appointment
messages.body: Reminder: Dentist appointment tomorrow at 09:00. Reply to this message to reschedule.

messages.subject: Lindqvist Brewing - follow up
messages.body: Hi Hugo, I sent over the label proposal (4,900 EUR) 10 days ago, wanted to check you received it?

messages.subject: Pereira Architects intro
messages.body: Hello Nadia, I got your portfolio from Isla. We're in need of new identity and a portfolio site look. Can we talk next week?

messages.subject: Re: Pereira Architects intro
messages.body: Hi Ana, yes! How about Tuesday at 2pm?

messages.subject: Re: Pereira Architects intro
messages.body: Tuesday works.

messages.subject: Re: Pereira Architects intro
messages.body: Perfect, invite sent.

messages.subject: Brand refresh quote - Reed & Sons
messages.body: We need a refreshed identity, logo plus stationery. Can you quote?

messages.subject: Re: Brand refresh quote - Reed & Sons
messages.body: Of course. Based on our call, I'd propose 3,800 EUR for logo, colour palette, stationery and a short guideline PDF. Proposal attached.

messages.subject: Re: Brand refresh quote - Reed & Sons
messages.body: Thanks, looks reasonable. Let me run it past my brother and get back to you.

messages.subject: What's new in Cloudlane - March release notes
messages.body: Hi there, this month we shipped faster dashboards, SSO for all plans and a refreshed mobile app. See the full changelog on our blog. You are receiving this because you signed up for product updates.

messages.subject: Ceramics shop rebrand
messages.body: Hi, I'm Mei. I run a small ceramics studio and I'd like to rebrand. I don't have a big budget though, maybe under 1500?

messages.subject: Re: Ceramics shop rebrand
messages.body: Hi Mei, thanks! I could do a lighter package: logo + 2 label designs for 1,300 EUR. Does that suit?

messages.subject: Re: Ceramics shop rebrand
messages.body: Hmm, that's a bit over what I can do right now. Maybe next year, I'll keep in touch!

messages.subject: Re: Ceramics shop rebrand
messages.body: Totally understand. Door's open anytime.

messages.subject: Re: Marini Foods label project
messages.body: Quick update: we're expecting the product photos on Friday, will send then.

messages.subject: Re: Marini Foods label project
messages.body: Perfect, thanks Sofia.

messages.subject: Re: Marini Foods label project
messages.body: ok!

messages.subject: Quick q about pricing
messages.body: hey nadia, how much for a poster for a gig? ben

messages.subject: poster
messages.body: Hi Ben, for a single A2 poster, 350 EUR including 2 revision rounds.

messages.subject: Re: poster
messages.body: ok cool will think abt it

messages.subject: Revised proposal for Wright Fit
messages.body: Can you also add gym signage to the scope? Ok to quote it separately.

messages.subject: Re: Revised proposal for Wright Fit
messages.body: Sure, I'll put together a separate quote and send it Monday.

messages.subject: proposal question
messages.body: One more thought, if I only did the logo for 600 would that work?

messages.subject: Re: proposal question
messages.body: Yes! Logo only, 600 EUR, 2 concepts. Shall I get started?

messages.subject: Re: proposal question
messages.body: Yes please, I'll pay up front today.

messages.subject: RE: Haddad Legal - website graphics
messages.body: Hi Farid, thanks for getting in touch. My day rate is 420 EUR; for 12 icons and a header I'd estimate 2.5 days, so around 1,050 EUR.

messages.subject: Re: RE: Haddad Legal - website graphics
messages.body: Understood, I'll discuss with the partners.

messages.body: Nadia, we've got the all clear from the board. Please send the deposit invoice and we'll get things moving.

messages.subject: Re: Wright Fit - invoice for deposit?
messages.body: Paid. Let's go!
